name: Eye Contact Consistency
algorithm: Eye Contact Consistency — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye contact patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **注视Direction估计**: Per-frame gaze direction is estimated from iris position, eye corner landmarks, and head pose. The gaze vector is decomposed into horizontal and vertical components relative to the camera, determining whether the subject appears to be making eye contact.

2. **眼睛Contact模式分析**: Natural eye contact follows specific behavioral patterns — during conversation, humans alternate between direct eye contact and glancing away (typically maintaining eye contact 60-70% of time). The method models these patterns and checks whether the subject's gaze behavior follows expected psychological norms.

3. **注视-HeadCoordination**: When shifting gaze, natural eye movements combine eye rotation (saccades) with head rotation in coordinated vestibulo-ocular patterns. The method verifies gaze-head coordination — deepfakes may produce eye movements decoupled from head motion or show unnaturally stable gaze during head turns.

4. **Bilateral注视一致性**: Both eyes should converge on the same target point (vergence). The method checks that left and right eye gaze vectors intersect at a plausible depth. Deepfakes may produce strabismus-like artifacts where eyes appear to look in slightly different directions.

5. **时间注视Naturalness**: Gaze changes include saccades (fast, ballistic movements), smooth pursuit (tracking moving objects), and fixations (stable gaze). The method analyzes the temporal structure of gaze signals for correct velocity profiles. AI-generated eye movements often lack natural saccadic dynamics, producing either unrealistically smooth or jittery gaze patterns.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through eye contact consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
